Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment uses a hybrid approach (APPLE-MS) combining affinity purification (AP-MS) and proximity labeling (PL-MS) using the PafA enzyme and PupE. While the method involves covalent labeling of proteins, the PRIDE metadata explicitly states 'No PTMs are included in the dataset' and the search parameters described (PEAKS Studio) do not list specific PTM mass shifts, suggesting the labeling was used for enrichment rather than site-specific PTM analysis.

scope: The strong binding affinity between the Twin-Strep tag and streptavidin facilitates efficient enrichment and subsequent MS analysis.
100 μL biotin agarose (Sigma-Aldrich) was added to the supernatant and incubated at 4°C overnight.

30 μL STarm Streptactin Beads 4FF (Smart-Lifesciences Biotechnology, SA05300) were added to 3 mg cell lysate transfected with plasmid expressing the Twin-Strep-tag-fused bait protein in binding buffer (50 mM Tris-HCl, 150 mM NaCl, 20 mM MgCl2, pH 7.4) and incubated overnight at 4°C with rotation.
The washed beads were then directly processed for mass spectrometry.

Biotin-agarose enriched proteins were subjected to reduction with 10 mM DTT (37°C, 1 h) followed by alkylation using 25 mM iodoacetamide (dark incubation, 20 min). On-bead tryptic digestion was then performed at 37°C overnight
